Privacy & data inventory

Stored server-side: EvaluationRecords, form snapshots, PolicyRuns, HumanReviews, alerts, role assignments, audit events and configuration.

Not stored server-side: raw voice transcripts, raw email bodies, raw message transcripts, Genesys OAuth tokens, signed media URLs or raw EML/ZIP.

Browser only: normalized conversation content, with the configured cache lifetime. Search results have an independent short lifetime.

Browser sandbox evaluation history is separate. Clear or reset it using the existing browser controls.

Browser conversation cache hours

0 disables persistent conversation content. Default: 24 hours.

Server retention

Blank means retain indefinitely. Saving settings never deletes data. Evaluation purges also remove their dependent reviews. Active alerts are retained.

Cached Genesys data

Local to this browser. Search snapshots last 15 minutes; completed conversation content uses the lifetime configured in Privacy & retention (24 hours by default). An active Genesys session is required to view cached data. Disconnect clears that identity's cache.
